##### Project general facts

Oasis III is a residential complex by Breig Property that brings together townhouses and one-bedroom apartments in a modern design filled with natural light. The townhouses are arranged over two levels, each with its own plunge pool and a study overlooking a banana grove, while the apartments offer efficient layouts with thoughtful interior details.

The complex shares a swimming pool and a landscaped garden that give it a calm tropical atmosphere. Round-the-clock security provides peace of mind for residents and guests, and every townhouse comes with its own parking space for added convenience.

Interiors use durable natural materials combined with chic industrial finishes, offered in a choice of dark or light colour schemes. Kitchens are fully fitted with premium appliances, and the homes are delivered fully furnished, including decor and plants, ready to be lived in or rented out.

##### Parking

Private parking.

##### Location description and benefits

Berawa is a relaxed neighbourhood on the edge of Canggu on the southwest coast of Bali, known for its beach, surf breaks and spectacular sunsets. It is one of the most prestigious addresses in the Canggu area, with a trendy character and a warm, welcoming community.

The neighbourhood offers a diverse culinary scene with cafes, restaurants and eateries serving dishes from around the world, along with boutique shops selling local crafts. Wellness centres, yoga studios and spas sit alongside beach bars and live music venues, creating a lively but balanced lifestyle.

Berawa draws families, couples and solo travellers looking for a comfortable base close to the ocean, which sustains strong demand for holiday and long-stay rentals. This makes homes in the area appealing both for personal use and as a rental investment.
